author: kingpanther13
releaseNotes:
v5.2.0 - 2026-11-17
- feat: five dashboard tools instead of six (copy via hub_create_dashboard) (#581)
  - Dashboard tools are simpler: five tools instead of six.
    - Copy a dashboard with `hub_create_dashboard` and a `sourceId` (replaces `hub_clone_dashboard`); you can name the copy.
  - Reading a legacy Hubitat® Dashboard and confirming a dashboard delete each need fewer hub requests.
  - Updating a dashboard that no longer exists now says so instead of failing with an unclear hub error, and a legacy tile with a misspelled field is refused by name.
  - Dashboards follow the MCP device selection: unless Bypass Device Allowlist is on, a dashboard can't be given (or lose) a device MCP isn't allowed to use.
  - Two legacy dashboard edits sent at the same time no longer lose one of the changes.
  - An Easy Dashboard's "Local access only" setting is kept when you rename, update or copy the dashboard.
  - Legacy dashboard tiles can use the hub editor's own fields, such as a hub-variable tile's variable or a link tile's caption.
  - Pointing a dashboard tool at an app that isn't a dashboard now says "No dashboard found" instead of a misleading error.
  - The dashboard list can be read a page at a time on hubs with many dashboards.
